summarization: This smartphone UI screen is from the WomanLog calendar app. It is the first screen of a setup process, indicated by "1 / 6" at the top. The screen welcomes the user to the WomanLog calendar and prompts them to perform the initial setup. It also informs the user that they can edit these and other settings later via the Settings menu. At the bottom of the screen, there is a pink "NEXT" button for the user to proceed to the next step of the setup process.
